items.title: Subtitle Placement
items.summary: By carefully placing subtitles based on the confidence of the speaker, the glasses can ensure that critical information is always visible while reducing the risk of distracting the wearer with unnecessary text. This can improve overall user trust and satisfaction.
items.probe: Define one fixed subtitle position rule for V1: keep subtitles at the bottom center of the display.

choices.label: More Prominent
choices.description: Bias toward easier visibility over subtlety.

items.title: Confidence Display
items.summary: This improved confidence format will help build trust with users by providing clear, concise, and easily understandable certainty indicators, reducing uncertainty that could lead to confusion or misinterpretation.
items.probe: Choose one confidence display format for V1: label only or label plus short reason.

choices.description: Keep certainty display minimal and fast to parse.

choices.description: Expose a short reason to improve trust.

items.title: Memory/Cache Policy
items.summary: The system will maintain a high level of accuracy for frequently encountered people while managing the local memory size effectively, reducing the risk of cluttered or outdated memory objects that could lead to confusion or false positives.
items.probe: Set one local cache eviction rule for face/name memory in V1.

choices.label: Smaller Cache
choices.description: Bias toward tighter local memory and lower load.

choices.label: Recency First
choices.description: Bias toward recent names and conversations.

items.title: Phone/Cloud Boundary
items.summary: By making this decision explicit, we can streamline the V1 architecture and reduce complexity. This will allow us to focus on core functionality such as real-time subtitles and memory support without compromising battery life or social acceptability.
items.probe: Define one phone-local vs cloud fallback boundary for face/name recall lookup.

choices.label: Phone First
choices.description: Keep critical work local unless clearly necessary.

choices.label: Balanced Fallback
choices.description: Allow cloud assist for slower or richer lookups.
